program: A small spreadsheet. It reads a file of cells, one per line (B3 = SUM(A1:A3) * 2), works out every cell once, prints the sheet as a grid, says which cells went wrong and why, and writes a report beside the file. A cell that can't be worked out holds its reason as a value (#cycle, #div/0, #parse), so one bad cell doesn't stop the rest. Run it on the sample: ters run examples/sheet examples/sheet/budget.txt. The file's format is in the README.
